# Assessment Overview

This folder contains supplementary architecture and analysis documents generated during assessment.

- [architecture-diagram.md](./architecture-diagram.md): High-level application architecture and component relationship diagrams.
- [dependency-map.md](./dependency-map.md): External dependency inventory grouped by functional categories.
- [api-service-contracts.md](./api-service-contracts.md): API endpoints, communication patterns, and service interaction sequence.
- [data-architecture.md](./data-architecture.md): Persistence model, data boundaries, and caching observations.
- [configuration-inventory.md](./configuration-inventory.md): Configuration sources, runtime/build profiles, and sensitive setting inventory.
- [business-workflows.md](./business-workflows.md): Core business workflows, rules, and process sequence.
